sql_query_tool.name: sql_query_tool
sql_query_tool.description: Run a read-only SQL SELECT query against the PharmaSense database (compounds, clinical_trials, trial_sites, lab_results, adverse_events, research_documents). Only SELECT statements are permitted.

query.description: A parameterized SQL SELECT statement using ? placeholders.

params.description: Values to bind to the ? placeholders, in order.

vector_search_tool.name: vector_search_tool
vector_search_tool.description: Semantic search over the research_documents corpus. Returns the top-k most relevant passages, each with doc_id, title, doc_type, and date for citation.

ae_severity_classifier_tool.name: ae_severity_classifier_tool
ae_severity_classifier_tool.description: Classifies an adverse event's escalation priority based on severity, seriousness, and causality assessment.

compound_similarity_tool.name: compound_similarity_tool
compound_similarity_tool.description: Finds the compounds most similar to a given compound_id, based on target protein, therapeutic area, molecular weight, solubility, and toxicity score.

citation_formatter_tool.name: citation_formatter_tool
citation_formatter_tool.description: Formats a list of retrieved passages (from vector_search_tool) into a numbered citation block.

passages.description: The list of passage objects returned by vector_search_tool.

escalation_notifier_tool.name: escalation_notifier_tool
escalation_notifier_tool.description: Logs an adverse event escalation to a human reviewer. Has a real side effect (writes to escalations.log) — call at most once per event.
